eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Spokane, WA; at 2:16 PM on AUG 1, 2026 Effective until 7:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: LEVEL 3 Evacuation, GO, LEAVE NOW! for Spokane County Old Trails Fire! This may be your only notice. Spokane County Fire district 10 has crews working a Wildland Fire. AREA: WOODSIDE to NORTH, TRAILS to SOUTH. SPOKANE RIVER at WEST AND NINE MILE/ASSEMBLY to the EAST. Leave now due to life-threatening conditions! Monitor phone and media for more information.
